name.description: The display name for the application entry.

exec_path.description: The full path to the executable to run.

only_show_in.description: Semicolon-separated list of desktop environments where this application should be shown.

nodisplay.description: Whether to hide the application from menus.

startup_notify.description: Whether to show a startup notification when the application is launched.

terminal.description: Whether the application runs in a terminal window.
